general-counsel-agent.note: All ten checks on file after reviewing the three review sheets (movers, beta explainer, studio week), report.json spoken text, titles, captions and sources. Defamation screen: every company appears only with its Webull price data; no reason is given for any move, and the movers video says so. No person is named. The studio video describes the studio's own records only. Nothing commits the owner; delivery is to the owner only. AI review, not legal advice.

advertising-consumer-protection-counsel.note: Every number traces to a saved raw response, our documented beta calculation or a repo record (factcheck.py: 0 unmatched; coincidental matches re-checked by hand). Movers: raw/gainers.json and raw/losers.json (100 each; the 100th gainer is +18.45% and the 100th loser -9.57%, so the $1B+ lists above those lines are complete: 21 gainers, all at least +18.67%; 2 decliners, PLBL -18.28% and SIND -16.61%). NVDA $125.53 to $165.05, +$39.52, $3.98T and SPY +4.71% / QQQ +7.00% from raw/snapshot_*.json. Beta: Fidelity and Schwab glossary definitions and FINRA's point that beta is relative, not total, volatility (search excerpts, paraphrased); betas computed from raw/daily.json (61 Webull daily closes, Aug 28 to Nov 23, 60 daily changes, covariance/variance vs SPY), labeled 'our calculation'. 6.7x = 31.48/4.71; 0.4x = 1.90/4.71; 'more than twice its beta' = 6.69/3.06. Studio: book-kit/records (Robots Nov 19, Winter Nov 20, Valentine's Day Nov 23; 30 subjects, 64 pages each), pod-kit/research (20/25 each) and decisions, chart-lab results (9 validated Nov 19, 20 on Nov 23). No earnings or sales claims.

email-anti-spam-compliance-counsel.note: No commercial email. The delivery email goes to the owner only.

privacy-data-protection-counsel.note: No personal data. No person is named or shown; the owner isn't named or shown.

copyright-fair-use-counsel.note: Visuals are drawn from data and text by the kit's renderer; the voice is Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0); music is synthesized per video by music.py; fonts are Inter, Space Grotesk and JetBrains Mono (SIL OFL). Glossary definitions are paraphrased with credit, not quoted. The studio video shows titles only, not book or design artwork. No screenshots, logos or third-party footage.

financial-content-compliance-counsel.note: 'Educational only. Not financial advice.' is on screen at the end of all three and in every caption. No buy/sell call, target, prediction or performance promise. Movers show what moved and say no reason is given. The beta explainer defines a term with a dated real example and says beta is built from the past and isn't a promise. The studio video says the chart lab is research only and Edgex never places trades.

platform-terms-policy-counsel.note: The narrator is a synthetic (AI) voice over data graphics: on Instagram and Facebook turn on the 'AI info' label. Nothing realistic depicts a real person, so YouTube's altered-content disclosure isn't triggered, but disclosing the AI voice is still the safer choice. No branded-content relationship exists. Titles match the content (no misleading metadata).

kids-content-coppa-counsel.note: The studio video mentions children's coloring books but is made for adults (it's about the studio), so it isn't 'made for kids': no child appears, no child data is collected, and nothing asks kids to buy. The other two are adult finance content.

contracts-commercial-terms-counsel.note: No proposal, quote, offer or contract; nothing is sold or promised in these videos.
